arn_parse.hot_path: io.github.hectorvent.floci.core.common.AwsArnUtils — parse(arn) + arnToQueueUrl on a fixed SQS ARN

jackson_ssm_parameter_roundtrip.hot_path: Jackson ObjectMapper (+JavaTimeModule) serialize+deserialize roundtrip of io.github.hectorvent.floci.services.ssm.model.Parameter (fixed instance, 271-byte JSON)

xml_builder_build.hot_path: io.github.hectorvent.floci.core.common.XmlBuilder — builds a fixed SQS ReceiveMessageResponse XML document (Query protocol response path)

xml_parser_extract.hot_path: io.github.hectorvent.floci.core.common.XmlParser — extractAll(Body) + extractPairs(Attribute) on a fixed XML request document (StAX parse path)

config.inputs: fixed deterministic strings in PerfBench (no randomness, no seed needed)
config.metric: median ns/op across the 5 rounds; baseline value is the median of 3 full harness runs

environment.jdk_note: Repo pom.xml sets maven.compiler.release=25 and AGENTS.md states Java 25, but only JDK 21 is installed on this VM, so the full Maven/Quarkus build was not run. The harness compiles the actual repo sources of the measured classes with JDK 21 (they use no post-21 language features) and runs them directly.
environment.vm: shared VM, ~1.5 effective CPU, ~7.7 GB RAM — results are noisy; observed run-to-run spread was roughly 2-3x on the smallest benchmarks. Treat deltas below ~25% as inconclusive on this machine.

framework: custom timing harness (javac + java, no Quarkus boot, no JMH in repo)
